story.iWant: to set up logging that captures debug info for troubleshooting
story.soThat: I can debug API failures and data issues easily
story.tasks:
- [ ] Create logging module structure (AC: #1, #2, #3) - [ ] Create `/src/bet_bot/utils/` directory (if not exists) - [ ] Create `/src/bet_bot/utils/__init__.py` - [ ] Create `/src/bet_bot/utils/logging.py` as main logging configuration - [ ] Import required modules: `logging`, `sys`, `pathlib`, `datetime`
- [ ] Configure console handler (AC: #2, #4, #5) - [ ] Create `StreamHandler(sys.stdout)` for console output - [ ] Use rich-compatible formatter with timestamps: `[%(asctime)s] %(levelname)s [%(name)s:%(lineno)d] %(message)s` - [ ] Set console handler level from environment (default INFO) - [ ] Configure color support (UNIX: auto-detect, Windows: check support) - [ ] Test: logs appear in console with proper formatting
- [ ] Configure file handler (AC: #3, #4, #5) - [ ] Create `~/.bet-bot/logs/` directory on first run - [ ] Use `RotatingFileHandler` with daily rotation - [ ] Log filename: `{YYYY-MM-DD}.log` format - [ ] Implement rotation: 10MB per file, keep 5 backups - [ ] Use JSON-structured log format for files: `{"timestamp":"...", "level":"...", "logger":"...", "message":"..."}` - [ ] Set file handler level to DEBUG (always capture full detail) - [ ] Test: log file created and entries written
- [ ] Implement log level configuration (AC: #6) - [ ] Create `setup_logging(level: str = "INFO")` function - [ ] Read `LOG_LEVEL` from environment variable (config module) - [ ] Validate level is one of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR - [ ] Default to INFO if missing or invalid - [ ] Apply level to root logger and console handler - [ ] Test: Setting `LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG` shows debug logs
- [ ] Suppress noisy library logs (AC: #1) - [ ] Set `httpx` logger to WARNING level (suppress connection debug spam) - [ ] Set `httpcore` logger to WARNING level - [ ] Set `openai` logger to INFO level - [ ] Document which libraries are suppressed and why
- [ ] Implement API key masking (AC: #7) - [ ] Create `mask_value(value: str, length: int = 8)` utility function - [ ] Mask pattern: show first 4 chars + "..." + last 4 chars - [ ] Return "****" if value too short - [ ] Use in logs when debugging config: `api_key={Config.get_masked_key(...)}` - [ ] Test: Logs never show full API keys
- [ ] Create logger factory function (AC: #1) - [ ] Create `get_logger(name: str)` function - [ ] Returns `logging.getLogger(name)` - standard pattern - [ ] Document usage: `logger = get_logger(__name__)` - [ ] Export from `__init__.py` for easy import
- [ ] Integration with config module (AC: #6) - [ ] Import logging in `config/__init__.py` after Config loaded - [ ] Call `setup_logging(config.log_level)` at module import - [ ] Document in config.py docstring that logging is auto-initialized - [ ] Test: `from bet_bot.config import config` initializes logging
- [ ] Integration with CLI (AC: all) - [ ] Import logging in `/src/bet_bot/cli/main.py` - [ ] Call `setup_logging()` before parsing CLI arguments - [ ] Log CLI startup: "Starting bet-bot {version}" - [ ] Log selected options on verbose mode - [ ] Test: `bet-bot analyze --bankroll 1000` logs startup info
- [ ] Create `.bet-bot/logs` directory manager (AC: #3) - [ ] Create `ensure_log_directory()` function in logging.py - [ ] Creates `~/.bet-bot/logs/` if missing - [ ] Handles permission errors gracefully (warn, don't crash) - [ ] Document fallback behavior (use temp directory if permission denied)
- [ ] Documentation and validation (AC: all) - [ ] Add docstrings to all logging functions - [ ] Document log format (console vs file) - [ ] Document how to configure log level - [ ] Add example: "How to debug a failing API call with logs" - [ ] Test: All logging flows work as expected

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Create logger configuration in `/src/bet_bot/utils/logging.py` 2. Log to console (colored output via `rich`) 3. Log to file: `~/.bet-bot/logs/{date}.log` (user home directory) 4. Log levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR 5. Include timestamps, log level, module name in each log 6. Respect `LOG_LEVEL` environment variable 7. Never expose API keys in logs

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Logging Setup with console handler (human-readable), file handler (structured JSON), and suppressed loggers (httpx, httpcore, openai). File rotation: 10MB per file, keep 5 backups.

doc.title: Development Stories
doc.snippet: Logging system must capture DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR level logs, write to console (colored output) and file with rotation (daily, max 10MB), include timestamps and source context, respect LOG_LEVEL environment variable, and never leak API keys.

doc.title: Project Standards - Logging Configuration
doc.snippet: ALWAYS use structured logging (JSON format for files), ALWAYS log to file AND console, ALWAYS include context (timestamps, levels, module), NEVER use print() for logging, ALWAYS rotate log files (10MB max, 5 backup), ALWAYS suppress noisy libraries.

doc.snippet: Config class uses Pydantic, singleton instance exported from config/__init__.py, environment variables loaded via python-dotenv. Logging integration point: call setup_logging(config.log_level) after Config loaded.

ideas.idea: Test logger factory: get_logger("module.name") returns logging.Logger with correct module name propagation
Test repeated calls: get_logger("same.name") returns same logger instance for idempotency
Test console handler creation: setup_logging() creates StreamHandler targeting sys.stdout
Test console formatter: logs appear with [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS] LEVEL [module:line] format on console
Test file handler creation: setup_logging() creates RotatingFileHandler for ~/.bet-bot/logs/{date}.log
Test file formatter: log file contains JSON-structured lines parseable with json.loads()
Test rotation configuration: RotatingFileHandler maxBytes=10MB, backupCount=5 per AC specs
Test log levels: setup_logging("DEBUG") sets root logger and console to DEBUG level
Test log level filter: DEBUG logs only show with LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG in config
Test default level: setup_logging() defaults to INFO level when no argument provided
Test environment variable: LOG_LEVEL=WARNING from Config suppresses INFO/DEBUG in console (not in file)
Test invalid level: Config.validate_log_level() in settings.py rejects invalid log levels
Test library suppression: setup_logging() sets httpx logger to WARNING, httpcore to WARNING, openai to INFO
Test API key masking: Sensitive values masked with first-4 + ... + last-4 pattern (use Config.get_masked_key())
Test no key exposure: logger.debug() with API keys uses masked version, never shows full key
Test directory creation: ensure_log_directory() creates ~/.bet-bot/logs if missing
Test directory exists: ensure_log_directory() returns existing path if ~/. bet-bot/logs already exists
Test permission handling: ensure_log_directory() gracefully handles permission errors (log warning, fallback to tempdir)
Test module imports: from bet_bot.utils import get_logger, setup_logging succeeds with correct exports in __init__.py
Test integration with config: Importing from bet_bot.config auto-initializes logging via setup_logging(config.log_level)
Test CLI integration: python -m bet_bot.cli analyze --bankroll 1000 logs startup without exposing secrets in output
Test multiple handlers: Both console and file handlers receive logs in same call (verify isolation)
Fixture: Create tmpdir fixture for log directory testing (use pytest tmp_path)
